facts.advisory_summary:
AIOHTTP: Absolute-form request targets can spoof Request.scheme — ### Summary

An attacker sending an absolute-form request can spoof the scheme used.

### Impact

### Workaround

A WAF rule to reject absolute-form requests (legitimate requests should only use this form for proxies).

Disable compression if unable to upgrade.

An attacker who uses this vulnerability can craft a PDF which leads to an infinite loop. This requires accessing the outlines/bookmarks.

### Patches

This has been fixed in [pypdf 6.6.2](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/releases/tag/6.6.2).

### Workarounds

If projects cannot upgrade yet, consider applying the changes from PR [#3610](https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf/pull/3610).

Dify never imports pypdf (PDFs go to pypdfium2, extract_processor.py:112,146). Needs outline/bookmark access; not called.

### Workarounds

# use the strict mode:
reade
